title: docs(metadata-protocol): name every asker of the record-currency follow door in the registry-question header
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDwkEEJd65kqFZGFjQnzBQt)_

Fixes #32934

Item 2 (N3) moved to #33593 (filed by seat 5 with its ruling, p2, lease:E2b); the card closes with this PR.

Clause-②: no

This PR lands item 1 of the card (prose only). Item 2 (N3) was measured, not implemented: the gap is reachable from a running install, so closing it is a narrowing that owes its own card, contract review and changeset (reported to the dispatching seat as a decision). The card stays open for that half until the seat files the follow-up card.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改了 `registry-question.ts` 文件头的一段注释，写清「金额跟随父记录币种」这道检查由三方来问：单个保存或发布、批量写入、运行中安装、升级或热重载在整次登记结束时。代码行为不变。
- 为什么改：原注释说这道检查「只有单个保存会问」，批量写入和运行中安装早已也在问，下一个读代码的人会被误导。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险，只是注释；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/registry-question.ts` 第 7 至 30 行的文件头。
- 两分钟验证：打开该文件头，对照 `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts` 中 `recordCurrencyFollowRefusal` 上方列出的三方提问者，应一一对应。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。另：第 2 项（扩展层贡献的跟随金额无人检查）已实测可达，需另开卡并裁决，见下方 Acceptance notes。

## What changes

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/registry-question.ts`: the header no longer says the follow door is asked by "nothing else" than the single save. It now names every asker, each asking once its unit is whole on a sealed registry, and states that `registerObject` itself never asks:
  - a single save or publish, of its one body before it registers (`againstRegistry`);
  - a batch writer, of each object row once all its rows are registered (`batch-object-registration.ts`);
  - a registration run on a running server (an install, an upgrade, a reload), of every object layer it registered, once at the end of the outermost run (`SchemaRegistry.restoringOnRefusal`), which is no producer in `REGISTRY_QUESTION_PRODUCERS` because it calls neither `saveMetaItem` nor `promoteDraftForPublish`.
  - It also states that an `extend` layer is asked only of its own roll-ups (the door's `partial` rule), which is the current behaviour item 2 measures.
- The list mirrors the one under `recordCurrencyFollowRefusal` in `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`; no code, export or behaviour changes.

## Tests

No test added: the diff is a comment, and pinning prose is not a behaviour pin. Item 2 was measured with a throwaway probe (not committed), see Acceptance notes.

## Acceptance notes

### Item 2 (N3): a following amount contributed by an `extend` layer — MEASURED, reachable

Measured on this branch (`objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `0e0ddc79b`, base `4bba8b8f0`), through the engine's `manifest` service after `start()` with `source: 'marketplace'` (the way the marketplace install door hands an artifact over), the harness of `packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts`. Package `ledger` (installed first) owns `led_invoice` (an ISO 4217 code field `currency_code`, and a plain text `title`) and `led_line` (a `master_detail` field `invoice` to it).

<details><summary>Readings (probe: 9 cases, 9 passed; each case prints the install outcome)</summary>

| Case | What the installed package carries | Outcome |
|:--|:--|:--|
| M1 | only `objectExtensions` on `led_line`: an amount with `currencyMode: 'record'` following `invoice.title` (a field holding no code) | ADMITTED; the served `led_line` carries the amount following `invoice.title` |
| M2 | the same, following `invoice.no_such_field` | ADMITTED |
| M3 | the extension adds its own `master_detail` `inv2` and an amount following `inv2.title` | ADMITTED |
| M4 | one install registers the parent as an `own` object AND extends another package's child with the bad amount | REFUSED `RecordCurrencyFollowRefusedError`, `INVALID_METADATA`, 422 (the parent's ask reads the served child) |
| C1 (control) | the same bad amount in an `own` object body | REFUSED, `INVALID_METADATA`, 422 |
| C2 (consequence) | after M1's package is installed, the `ledger` owner re-registers unchanged (a patch upgrade) | REFUSED 422 on `led_line.ext_amount`: the innocent owner's upgrade is refused over the extension's amount |
| A1 | `defineStack` of M1's package (extension only) | ADMITTED (the stack holds neither end, so the cross-reference pass skips it, as documented) |
| A2 (control) | `defineStack` holding both ends with the bad pair | REFUSED (cross-reference validation) |

</details>

Reading: none of the three askers judges a following amount an `extend` layer contributes: the run end asks the extension layer with `partial: true`, which judges only its own roll-ups and returns before the following-amount half and the other-ends half. It is caught only incidentally, when the same run (M4) or a later one (C2) registers the parent. NOT MEASURED: what a write of the admitted amount does (the probe kernel had no driver), and whether a single save of an `object_extension` item reaches the same `partial` path.

Closing it is a narrowing (an install admitted today would be refused), so per the card it is not implemented here; it is reported to the dispatching seat as a decision for its own card.

### Stale-prose siblings, noted and not changed

`protocol-package-commits.ts` (two sites) and `protocol-save.ts` call the follow door one "which no registration asks". Read as "no single registration" it still holds (`registerObject` never asks it); read as "no registration run" it is false since the run end asks it. Outside this card's named surface; noted here only.
